disclaimer: Simplified estimate. Panama uses a TERRITORIAL tax system: only Panama-sourced income is taxed for residents and non-residents alike; foreign-sourced income is fully exempt for everyone regardless of residency, and this calculator does not model that exemption (it assumes all entered salary is Panama-sourced). Social security (CSS), the 10% married-with-dependents deduction, and other personal deductions are not included.

regimes.label: Resident (Progressive)
regimes.notes: Progressive rates on Panama-sourced taxable income. An alternative minimum tax of 6% of gross taxable income can apply above B/.60,000 if higher than the progressive result — not modeled here.

regimes.label: Non-Resident
regimes.notes: Non-residents rendering services in Panama for under 183 days are subject to a flat 15% withholding tax on gross Panama-sourced income (plus a small separate educational insurance tax not modeled here).

residency_threshold_note: ADVISORY ONLY, not a legal determination: 183+ days physically present in a tax year is commonly used as a resident-status guideline. Actual rules vary by country (tie-breaker tests, visa type, permanent home, center of vital interests, etc.) and this figure does not override your own judgment or professional advice.
